segments.an4.223:1.1: “Catūhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bālo abyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati, sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo viññūnaṃ, bahuñca apuññaṃ pasavati.
segments.an4.223:1.3: Kāyaduccaritena, vacīduccaritena, manoduccaritena, akataññutā akataveditā – imehi … pe … paṇḍito … kāyasucaritena, vacīsucaritena, manosucaritena kataññutākataveditā … pe ….
